summary.title: G.S.R. 700(E) — Companies (Specification of Definition Details) Amendment Rules, 2022, dated 15-09-2022
summary.existence_note: Failure to DISCOVER an instrument is not evidence that the instrument does not exist. Every outcome below is a fact about a host or an address -- a refusal, an outage, a wrong path -- and none of them is a fact about the law. Disproving existence would require reading a source that would list the instrument if it existed; no such source was read. Existence stays undetermined, and nothing downstream may treat absence-from-corpus as absence-from-law.

records.note: robots.txt unavailable on three consecutive attempts. checker.robots fails closed on 5xx per RFC 9309 (a 4xx means no rules exist; a 5xx means we cannot know them), so the compliant fetcher declines the bitstream. The item and its text bitstream are themselves reachable — the gate is the block, not the document.

records.error: SSLCertVerificationError: unable to get issuer certificate
records.note: Alternative official source. Server presents a valid Let's Encrypt leaf (CN=YR2, valid 2026-07-21 to 2026-10-19) but sends no intermediate. Fetching the intermediate via the certificate's own AIA URI moved the failure up one level: YR2 chains to ISRG 'Root YR', absent from this machine's trust store (/etc/ssl/cert.pem). NOT resolved by side-loading that root — a root obtained over plain HTTP is trusted on the say-so of an untrusted transport, which is not verification. The fix is to update the local trust store, not to weaken the check.
